field_changes.before: Would not affect the existing Google data center project under construction in southeast Fort Wayne
field_changes.after: The rejected proposal concerned final discretionary Common Council approvals for new hyperscale or large-scale data-center developments, aggregating related phases, expansions and facilities under common ownership/control, contiguous sites, shared infrastructure or the same planned development. It excluded principally telecommunications and emergency-communications facilities and preserved prior lawfully granted approvals. It requested corresponding measures by other approving bodies without directing action beyond their legal authority, and allowed study/planning/review short of final Council approval. The failed bill imposed no moratorium on any project.
